_comment: Star Quarry orbital mining (GitHub #142). use_worldgen: ores come from the world generation of the quarry's dimension, weighted by how much of each ore the world generates (false = only the loot tables data/scc/loot_table/quarry/orbital/<tier>). Items per haul follow the tier's loot table. weights: factor per ore block (0 = never). extra: per dimension, ore blocks with a fixed raw weight (an overworld iron ore vein is about 900). Never-pulled blocks: block tag #scc:orbital_blacklist.
